title: Revelations of Divine Love
author: Julian of Norwich (Warrack ed)
description: Julian of Norwich reflects on the visions she received during illness, exploring divine love, suffering and hope. This classic of Christian mysticism offers a sustained meditation on God's relationship with humanity.
